title: Whim — A World of Eleven Giants
summary: Built **Whim**, a multiplayer browser revival of Glitch featuring all five interconnected streets (**Chego Chase**, **Andra Bureaucratic Hall**, **Bongul Beat**, **Goli Grabs**, and **Beau's Home Street** with its interior room), customizable 2D cartoon avatars with full skeletal animations (including Pickaxe mining, Shovel digging, watering, scale buffs, and synchronized Thriller zombie dancing), and procedural WebAudio sounds and street music. Implemented the complete UI chrome and progression loop—including Mood/Energy/iMG/Currants gauges, the 16-slot inventory bar with expandable bag sub-slots and custom vector icons, Giant Shrines, Street Spirit vendors, the 15-second bureaucratic waiting room timer, racing Cubimals, real-time Skills, Quests, World Map teleportation, conga lines, and co-op harvesting.
